method: Each occurrence was linked only when its scanner byte range had exactly one offset overlap with a structured table field; raw slices and whole-payload SHA-256 were verified. Substring candidates were never deciding evidence.

action_lists.recommended_action: Exclude ambiguous/unmatched units until raw structural evidence exists; rewrite fixed-field overflows or use a proven resizable path; append missing glyphs and rerender the font for encoding errors.
